neighbours.label: South Asian religious and agricultural context (Hindus, holy day, crops)
fire: Diwali is one of the most important festivals of Hindus across India.
Akshaya Tritiya is considered a holy day for Hindus and Jains.
The important crops of Punjab are wheat, rice and sugarcane.
Holi is celebrated by Hindus with colours and music in spring.
In Bihar the main crops are paddy, maize and lentils.
Many Hindus fast and pray during the festival of Navratri.
Farmers in Uttar Pradesh grow crops such as wheat and mustard.
Cases of dengue fever rose sharply in Delhi after the monsoon.
quiet: Christmas is one of the most important festivals of Christians across Europe.
Easter Sunday is considered a holy day for Catholics and Protestants.
The important exports of Belgium are machinery, chemicals and diamonds.
Carnival is celebrated in Venice with masks and music in winter.
In Bavaria the main industries are cars, machinery and tourism.
Many Catholics fast and pray during the season of Lent.
Engineers in Stuttgart build machines such as engines and pumps.
Cases of influenza rose sharply in Berlin after the holidays.
